The Battle Friend is an enemy only encountered through the {{E2|Battleworn Dummy}} event in [[StS2:Glory|Glory]]. Each option in this event has you fight a different version of the Battle Friend, from V1.0 to V3.0. Each subsequent version has double the HP of the last.

== Pattern ==
{{Intents Table/start|Battle Friend}}
{{Intents Table/row

|Effect = Does Nothing.
}}
{{Intents Table/end}}
Always does nothing.
